about: The words ledger's debug op (M13.1), which v1 did not have: what the ledger kept lately, for the person only (the handler refuses anyone else; `parse` does not decide who may run an op). Each case is a command line, who typed it, and the op or error `ops::parse` gives.
recorded: Not recorded from the app: v1 had no `words` command, so no case has `v1`. Written with M13.1 from what `ops::parse` gives.
rules: Never edit a case: a changed golden stops the plan (slice plan section 9). A case without `v1` is a caller the recording could not be.
